s: Din taarobot chametz betok happesach ubo s"g seipim: ap al pi shekkol issurin shebbattora shennitarebu enan oserin taarobtan ella kede litten taam battaarobot, dehaynu ad shishshim, abal chametz shennitareb betok happesach dehaynu millel t"v ad motzae yom tob haacharon shel pesach, kevan shehechemira bo tora laanosh karet velaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", ubene adam mechamat shehen regilin bo kol hashshana hen qerobin leshikcha, lepikak hechemiru bo chakamim sheoser taarobto bemashshehu, ben baakila ben bahanaa, ben shennitareb yabesh beyabesh (perush shennitareb tzonen betzonen o cham becham belo roteb, abal im hen munnachin beroteb roteach, haynu lach belach, shehare niplat taam haissur betok hahetter kemo sheyyitbaer), kegon perusat pat shel tebua mechummetzet shennitareb beelep perusot shel matztza, uben shennitareb lach belach, kegon shekar mittebua mechummetzet shennapal letok me debash shel pesach, ben shennitareb besheeno mino uben shennitareb bemino, dehaynu sheshshenehen shavin betaman, kegon chatikat pat shennillosha miqqemach shel tebua mechummetzet shennopla liqdera matztza mebushshelet, vaapillu en battaarobet kelum mammashut hechametz, kegon shehu makkir et chatikat chametz shennopla laqqedera vehesirah min haqqedera miyyad, ap al pi ken taam mashshehu shenniplat mimmenna letok haqqedera oser bahanaa apillu et hammatztza sheshshava lah battaam. Umikkol maqom, im en mammashut hechametz kelum battaarobet apillu mashshehu — yesh mattirin limkor lenokri kol hattaarobet (im hu dabar sheen lachosh shemma yachazor hannokri veyimkor hattaarobet leyisrael acher sheeno yodea sheyyesh bo taarobet chametz veyoklenna bepesach kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b), shehare en hannokri mosip lo damim bead taam hechametz mashshehu shebbetoko, venimtza sheeno neheneh kelal mehechametz. Raq sheyyizzaher limkor kol hattaarobet tekep umiyyad shennitareb bo hechametz sheasur lehashhoto bepesach (ella im ken hu yom shemini shel pesach kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z), shemma yishkach veyoklennu. Veap al pi shekkol maakalot asurot muttar lehashhotan zeman muat kemo chodesh o shene chodashim, veen chosheshin shemma yishkach veyoklennu kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman n"z, mikkol maqom chametz kevan shehu ragil bo kol hashshana yesh lachosh yoter leshikcha. Ulepikak hechemiru bo chumrot harbeh vegaderu kamma gedarim kede lehitracheq mimmennu, ulekak en lilmod mimmennu lishar issure tora. Abal im yesh battaarobot mashshehu mammashut chametz vehu meorab bo keen taarobot lach belach, shehen niblalin yapeh shei epshar lehapridan zeh mizzeh, kegon qemach mittebua chamutza shennitareb veniblal im qemach shel tebua sheenah chamutza, shehaqqemach hu nimmoach veniblal bekol haqqemach shel hetter, vei epshar lemaet qemach min hattaarobet shello yihyeh bo mashshehu min qemach shel issur — asur limkor lenokri kol hattaarobot apillu chutz middeme issur shebbo, dehaynu shello yittol mimmennu damim raq mah shehattaarobet haya shaveh qodem shennitareb hechametz betoko. Lepi shello hittiru chakamim laasot ken ella bechametz shennitareb yabesh beyabesh, dehaynu kikkar shel chametz shennitareb im shene kikkarot shel matztza, shehaissur vehahetter enan niblalin zeh bazeh ella kol echad veechad omed bipne atzmo, raq sheen anu makkirin et haissur veillu hayinu makkirin oto haya epshar lehaprido mishsham, ulepikak keshemmokero lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbo, kevan sheeno notel damim bead haissur — hare zeh keillu maprido min hahetter. Abal kol shehaissur meorab behetter keen taarobot lach belach shei epshar lehapridan zeh mizzeh — lo hittiru chakamim laasot ken, ella tzarik lebaer kol hattaarobot min haolam miyyad, ella im ken en battaarobot kelum mammashut hechametz ella taam mashshehu shenniplat mimmennu letok hattaarobet. Veyesh omerim deqemach shennitareb en lo din taarobet lach belach sheasur limkor hattaarobet lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbo, ella yesh lo din taarobet yabesh beyabesh, ella im ken nitareb tebua mechummetzet bitbua sheenah mechummetzet vetachan et hattaarobet, azay yesh lehaqqemach hayyotze mimmennu din taarobot lach belach, sheal yede hattechina mitorbin veniblalin yapeh haqqemach shel issur im haqqemach shel hetter. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh:

Abal yesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim daapillu en battaarobet kelum mammashut hechametz ella shenniplat lesham taam chametz mashshehu — asur lemokro lenokri, ella sorepin kol hattaarobet miyyad. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu. Veen leshannot hamminhag ella im ken yesh hepsed gadol (meod), sheaz yesh lismok al sebara harishona. Abal betaarobet yabesh beyabesh ledibre hakkol yakol lemokro lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbo, kemo shennitbaer. Abal asur lo littol mehannokri deme kol hattaarobet im hechametz shebbetoko ulehashlik deme hechametz shebbo layyam, sheen taqqana zo moelet ella baaboda zara abal lo bishar issure hanaa, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"y, ayyen sham hattaam:

Kelim shennitbashshel bahen chametz bepesach meshapshepan umedichan heteb shello yehe chametz nireh bahen beayin, shehechametz habbalua baddepanot eno ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", shehare eno matzuy leka, lepikak muttar lehashhotan ad leachar happesach, sheaz muttar lebashshel bahen belo hagala veheksher kelal. Raq sheyyizzaher lehatznian bemaqom tzanua kol yeme happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"a. Veken muttar lemokran apillu betok happesach. Veken lehanniach betokan dabar tzonen derek aray, o lehachem bahen mayim chammin lirchitza velikbisa derek aray — muttar apillu bepesach, kedin keli shennitbashshel bo chametz qodem happesach, kemo she[yi]tebbaer besiman t"n, velo chashu chakamim im yashheh otam ad leachar happesach shemma yishkach vibashshel bahen betok happesach kemo shechasheshu bemaakal hanneesar baakila bepesach mishshum chashasha zo:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Shechametz bepesach oser taarobto bepesach bemashshehu keshenniblal venitpashshet taam hechametz bekol hahetter, kegon mashshehu chametz shennapal letok tabshil cham shehayyad soledet bo, ben shennapal letok haroteb ben shennapal al gabbe chatikat basar shemmunnachat miqtzatah betok haroteb, sheharoteb molik taam hechametz mashshehu bekol haqqedera, ella shebbishar issurin mitbattel taam mashshehu zeh beshishshim, abal chametz bepesach eno mitbattel apillu bealpe alapim, ulepikak neesar kol mah shebbaqqedera:

Abal im lo nitpashshet taam hechametz bekol hahetter ella bemiqtzat mimmennu — en oser ella hammiqtzat shennitpashshet bo, vehashshear muttar apillu baakila. Ketzad? Kikkar chametz shehayyad soledet bo shennaga bekikkar matztza cham shehayyad soledet bo — eno oser ella meqom maggao, dehaynu sheyyasir mehammatztza et hammaqom shennaga bo hechametz, veyasir otah beomeq kerochab agudal, vehashshear muttar apillu baakila, shehare lo niplat lesham taam chametz kelal apillu mashshehu, dekevan sheen sham roteb leholik et taam hechametz — en taam hechametz holek meatzmo betibo yoter mimmeqom maggao. Veim bishshel et hammatztza shennaga bah chametz velo hesir meqom maggao, apillu im epshar lehasiro akshav shehu makkir et meqomo — hare kol matztza zo im kol mah shennitbashshel immah baqqedera hakkol asur, lepi shettaam hechametz shehaya balua bimqom maggao nitpashshet akshav bekol hattabshil al yede haroteb veoser et hakkol, shechametz bepesach bemashshehu:

Vekol zeh keshehahetter shennaga bo hechametz hu kachush kematztza vekayyotze bah, abal im hahetter hu shamen, kegon matztza hamshucha beshemen, o basar shamen tzali o mebushshal, vehu munnach kullo chutz laroteb — hare hashshamnunit shel hetter shebbimqom maggao hu mepattem umashmin et taam hechametz mashshehu hanniplat, veal yede ken mepapea taam mashshehu zeh umitpashshet bekol hahetter, kemo shehu derek kol dabar shamen lepapea ulehitpashshet keshehu cham kol kak ad shehayyad soledet bo, vekevan shennitpashshet taam chametz mashshehu bekol hahetter — hare hu oser et kullo, shechametz bepesach bekol maqom sheyyeshno eno mitbattel leolam:

Ubimdinot ellu nohagin lehachamir bebasar cham shennaga bo chametz cham leesor et kullo apillu hu kachush, lepi sheen anu beqiim lechalleq ben kachush leshamen, shellipamim habbasar nireh kachush mibbachutz vehu shamen mibbipnim. Lepikak nohagin lehachamir bekol dabar sheshshayyak bo shamnunit leesor et kullo bahanaa im naga bo chametz ushenehem chammin ap al pi sheen sham roteb. Veen anu meqillin ella bechametz shennaga bematztza vekayyotze bah middebarim shei epshar limtzo bahem shum tzad sheyyihyeh bahem shamnunit, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"a vetas"z, ayyen sham kol perate dinim ellu:

Ap al pi shechametz bepesach oser bemashshehu, sheen taam hechametz nirgash betaarobto, mikkol maqom im hechametz noten taam lipgam behattaarobet eno oser kelal apillu baakila, ben shennitareb mimmennu harbeh beinyan sheyyesh bo kede litten taam lipgam behattaarobet, ben shello nitareb mimmennu ella meat sheen tamo pogem hattaarobet lepi sheeno nirgash kelal, lepi shekkol taam sheppogem battaarobet eno niqra taam kelal, ukeillu lo niplat kelal letok hattaarobet. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim: kevan shechametz bepesach oser bemashshehu, veen leka bittul taam yoter mimmashshehu bealpe alapim veap al pi ken asur, vehu haddin lenoten taam lipgam, ben sheyyesh bo kede litten taam lipgam ben sheen bo. Vaapillu mashshehu shennitareb bealpe alapim oser hakkol baakila ubahanaa. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu. Abal bemaqom sheen sham minhag yadua yesh lehorot shehammeqel kassebara harishona lo hipsid, abal hammachamir tabo alayv beraka:

Ap al pi sheshshear issurin enan oserin et hahetter ella im ken natenu taam bahetter, abal im en bahetter kelum mittaam haissur ap al pi shenniqlat bo reach haissur en reach zeh oser et hahetter kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"ch, abal chametz bepesach kevan shehu oser taarobto bemashshehu ap al pi sheen toamin taam hechametz battaarobet, lepikak gam recho asur, kegon kikkar chametz shenneepa betannur ubeet apiyyato hu nitzla battannur basar shamen, ben shennitzla beshappud ben shennitzla biqdera megulla — hare reach hashshamnunit shel hatztzali niknas behakkikkar umepattem et recho, vechozer reach hashshamnunit umolik immo reach hakkachush shel hechametz veyablio batztzali. Vehu shehattannur qatan sheeno machaziq y"b esronim shel matztza (dehaynu sheen yekolin leepot beqarqaito bebat achat y"b kikkarot shel matztza shel issaron issaron, voobi kol kikkar hu pachot mittepach mashshehu, kedin apiyyat hammatztzot sheyyitbaer besiman t"s), upi hattannur hu satum, ap al pi sheeno satum legamre ella patuach qetzat min hatztzad, veken yesh battannur neqeb pi patuach lemala bammaqom sheheashan yotze, ap al pi ken, kevan sheiqqar piv hu satum — en maqom lehareach lehitpashshet lachutz veniqlat behahetter. Bammeh debarim amurim? Betzali shamen, abal im hu kachush, veen tzarik lomar pat matztza shenneepet betannur echad im kikkarot shel chametz, apillu hechametz merubbeh mehammatztza hakkol muttar, apillu im hattannur satum legamre mikkol tzad veen bo shum neqeb patuach, vaapillu nishtahu hechametz vehahetter betoko kamma yamim, kevan shehem kechushim en recham nodep kelal. Vaapillu im hakkikkarot hen nilloshin beshumman o beshemen, ap al pi ken hen niqrain kechushim. Umikkol maqom, hammaqom shenneepeh sham hechametz tzarik hesseq lehakshiro leepot sham matztza, abal shear kol hattannur en tzarik, sheen beliat hechametz mitpashshetet bekullo belo roteb:

Veken im beet apiyyat hechametz nitbashshel battannur basar shamen biqdera eno neesar apillu nishtahu beyachad betok hattannur kamma yamim, lepi sheddabar hammitbashshel en recho nodep kol kak kemo reach hatztzali, veen bo koach lepattem et reach hechametz velachazor ulehablio betoko. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello haya hattannur satum legamre, abal im haya satum legamre velo haya bo shum neqeb patuach venishtaha betoko zeman merubbeh, apillu tabshil shel chametz shennitbashshel betannur echad im tabshil shel hetter veechad mehem hu shamen, ben shehaissur hu shamen ben shehahetter shamen, ushenehem megullin betok hattannur vehattannur hu satum legamre veen bo shum neqeb patuach, venishtahu hattabshilin betoko zeman merubbeh kemo shehu derek lehatmin chammin leshabbat betannur satum veshohin betoko harbeh — hare hakkol asur baakila ubahanaa, shehare enenu root shechammin hattemunim leshabbat yesh lahem reach chazaq. Abal im mebashshelin bechol shaa o shettayim vesotemin hattannur legamre lepi shaa — en lachosh shemma niqlat reach haissur behahetter ap al pi sheshshenehem shemenim. Veken im echad mehen mekusseh — en hareach shello yotze mimmennu velo reach acher niqlat letoko. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shereach hechametz bilbad eno oser kelal, kevan shello niqlat behahetter mittaam hechametz kelum apillu mashshehu. Ulepikak, ap al pi sheshshene hattabshilin hen shemenim vehem megullin betok hattannur shehu satum legamre venishtahu betoko kamma yamim veniqlat reach hechametz betabshil o betzali shel hetter — muttar leoklo bepesach. Ubimqom hepsed merubbeh o bishat haddechaq, kegon letzorek simchat yom tob sheen lo maakalim acherim — yesh lismok al dibrehem. Veken nohagin. Umikkol maqom, hammachamir — tabo alayv beraka:

Vekol zeh keshehaissur vehahetter shenehem enan middebarim hacharipim, abal im echad mehem hu dabar charip ushenehem megullin betok hattannur, apillu bishar issurin asur, apillu im hattannur gadol upatuach, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"ch, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Vekol zeh keshereach hechametz eno pogem bahetter, abal im hu lipgam bahetter — yesh lehattir bekol inyan, apillu en sham hepsed merubbeh, kevan sheyyesh mattirin apillu taam lipgam veken iqqar, kemo shennitbaer lemala:
Im satemu pi hattannur bepesach bedap shessotemin bo hattannur kol hashshana, ap al pi shello hedichu haddap kelal qodem shessatemu bo — ap al pi ken kol mah shebbattannur muttar:

Chametz bepesach shennitareb yabesh beyabesh, kegon chatikat chametz beelep chatikot matztza veneebda achat mehachatikot min haolam legamre, kegon shenneekla beshogeg o shennisrepa — hare kol hattaarobet muttar apillu baakila, sheanu tolin lomar otah hachatika shel chametz hi shenneebda min haolam, kevan shemmah shechametz bepesach eno mitbattel berob eno ella middibre soperim, usepeq dibrehem lehaqel, veal derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"y, ayyen sham hattaam im kol perate din zeh:

Vaapillu lo neebda shum chatika mehen, ella shennitareb miutan berob chatikot acherot shel matztza umittaarobet zo hashsheniyya nitareb miutan berob chatikot acherot shel matztza — hare hattaarobet zo hashshelishit mutteret baakila betok happesach, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"y, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Vekol zeh beyabesh, abal lach belach shennitareb betok happesach, apillu neebad rob hattaarobet min haolam — hare hashshear omed beissuro kemo shehaya. Veken im nitareb miqtzat taarobet zeh betaarobet shenit umehattaarobet hashshenit letaarobet shelishit umishshelishit lirbiit veken leolam, kegon tabshil shenneesar mechamat chametz mashshehu venapal meat roteb mittabshil zeh letabshil acher umittabshil sheni letabshil shelishi umishshelishi lirbii veken leolam — kullam asurin baakila ubahanaa. Veken chatikat basar shennitbashshela beechad mittabshilin hallalu shenneesru veneesra hi immahem veachar kak nitbashshela im tabshil acher, ap al pi sheyyesh beoto tabshil shishshim keneged otah hachatika — hare hi oseret et hakkol, lepi shemmashshehu chametz shennibla betabshil rishon nitpashshet bekol chelqe hattabshil, veen mashshehu battabshil shello yihyeh bo mashshehu mittaam hechametz, shemmashshehu en lo shiur, veyakol hu lehitpashshet ulehitchalleq lealpe alapim mashshehuyin, ukeshennapal meat roteb mittabshil zeh letabshil acher napal immo gam mashshehu mittaam hechametz venitpashshet mashshehu zeh bekol chelqe hattabshil, veken leolam. Veken chatikat basar shennitbashshela beechad mittabshilin hanneesarim, qibbela mashshehu mittaam hechametz mashshehu shebbattabshil, ukeshebbishshelah betabshil acher hi poletet meat mittaam chametz mashshehu shebbetokah veoseret kol hattabshil. Vaapillu nitorba chatika zo beelep chatikot yabesh beyabesh — kullan asurot baakila, ella yimkerem lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbahen kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veyesh mattirin apillu baakila im nitorba beb' chatikot acherot yabesh beyabesh, kevan sheen bachatika zo ella taam mashshehu chametz. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq, veyasir chatika achat lepi hamminhag shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"t:

Veken kap shehegis bo echad mehattabshilin hallalu veachar kak hegis bo bayyom (uleminhag medinot ellu sheoserim noten taam lipgam bepesach apillu hegis bo achar meet leet lahagasa rishona haddin ken) tabshil acher, ap al pi sheyyesh bo shishshim keneged hakkap hakkol asur bahanaa. Veken kol hakkelim sheshshimmeshu beoto tabshil keshehu cham shehayyad soledet bo, tzarik lehatznian ad leachar happesach. Veim nitareb echad mehakkelim hallalu beelep kelim acherim — tzarik lehatznian kullan ad leachar happesach, shechametz bepesach en lo bittul leolam beshum inyan. Veyesh omerim sheim nitareb echad mikkelim hallalu bishne kelim acherim — hare hu batel berob, kevan shello neesar ella mechamat mashshehu. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq, veyasir keli achat lepi hamminhag shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"t:

Vekol zeh betok happesach, abal qodem happesach, apillu beereb pesach mishshaa shishshit ad hallayla shehechametz asur az baakila ubahanaa min hattora, mikkol maqom kevan sheen bo karet lo hechemiru bo chakamim yoter mibbishar issure tora, ulepikak hu mitbattel beshishshim kishar issurin im nitareb lach belach, veim nitareb yabesh beyabesh nitbattel berob kemo bishar issurin (veeno niqra "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin", dehaynu leachar happesach, kevan sheap leachar happesach en lo hetter ella al yede shennitbattel berob, shehare hechametz shehu omed beeno sheabar alayv happesach asur bahanaa). Veken en recho oser ledibre hakkol. Veken noten taam lipgam muttar bo ledibre hakkol kemo bishar issurin. Veken haddin bechametz nuqsheh apillu betok happesach, dekevan sheen chayyabin alayv karet — hare dino kechametz gamur beereb pesach mishshesh ulemala:

Issat chametz shennopla lemayim tzonenin, ap al pi shennishret betokan meet leet — muttar lishtotan beereb pesach mishshesh ulemala achar shessinnenan, mippene shemmin hassetam issa shel chametz hu noten taam lipgam bammayim. Veken seorim notenim taam lipgam bammayim, shehen mabishin otam:

Kikkar shalem shel chametz shennitareb apillu beelep kikkarot shel matztza eno mitbattel betokam, veasur leekol mehattaarobet beereb pesach mishshaa chamishit vaelak, lepi shekkikkar shalem hu dabar shebbeminyan (perush shetztzarik lemokro beminyan mechamat chashibuto veeno nimkar beomed kemo shedderek limkor debarim sheenan chashubin), vekol dabar shebbeminyan apillu beelep lo batel, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"y:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehakkikkar hu asur mechamat atzmo shehu chametz, abal kikkar shel matztza shenneesar mechamat shennibla bo issur, kegon shemmatzeu bo chitta chamutza shenneepet betoko vehesirah mimmenna vetzarik lehasir mimmenna od matztza, veken matztza shennitkappela miqtzatah veachar shechatak mimmenna maqom hakkapul shehu chametz tzarik lehasir mimmenna od kede netila kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"a, mippene shennibla bah taam hechametz, veim qodem shehesir mimmenna kede netila nitorba baacherot — kullam muttarin, umuttar leoklam beereb pesach ad hallayla, veen tzarik lehasir mehem kelum, sheotah matztza habbelua meissur nitbattela berob, ap al pi shehu dabar shebbeminyan ap leachar shennechtak mimmennu meat, mikkol maqom hare hi beatzmah mutteret hi, vehaissur shebbetokah eno dabar shebbeminyan:

Apillu kikkar shennechtak mimmennu harbeh venitbattel chashibuto veachar kak nitareb biprusot acherot shel matztza — asur leekol velehanot mehattaarobet betok happesach millel t"v vaelak. Vaapillu lehashhotam ad leachar happesach asur, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b. Veap al pi shekkebar nitbattel haissur berob qodem happesach, kevan sheen gup haissur niblal begup hahetter ella hu omed bipne atzmo betok hattaarobet, lepikak keshemmaggia happesach hare hu chozer veneor veoser et kol hattaarobet keillu nitareb akshav bappesach. (Veyesh choleqin. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq, kemo sheyyitbaer). Abal chametz shennitareb behetter lach belach shehen niblalin, venitbattel qodem happesach beshishshim o mechamat shehu noten taam lipgam — muttar leoklo betok happesach, dekevan sheggup haissur balul begup hahetter venitbattel betoko — hare hu kemi sheeno baolam kelal, veeno chozer veneor bepesach. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim kevan sheyyesh mashshehu mammashut hechametz betok hattaarobet, ap al pi shehu balul begup hahetter, hu chozer veneor bepesach veoser et hattaarobet. Veyesh machamirin od daapillu im en betok hattaarobet kelum mimmammashut hechametz apillu mashshehu ella shenniplat lesham taam mashshehu chametz venitbattel betoko qodem happesach — hare hu chozer veneor bepesach, kegon tarnegolet mebushshelet shemmatza bah chitta mechummetzet vehesir mimmenna hachitta qodem happesach — asur leoklah betok happesach, mippene shettaam mashshehu shenniplat min hachitta lattarnegolet chozer veneor veoser et kol hattarnegolet. Vahalaka kassebara harishona. Umi sherotzeh lehachamir keachat mishshette sebarot haacharonot — yachamir leatzmo, abal lo yoreh ken laacherim. Abal im lo hesir hachitta min hattarnegolet ad shenniknas happesach, ap al pi shehotzi et hattarnegolet mehaqqedera qodem kenisat happesach vehinnichah biqara belo roteb, im keshenniknas happesach hayeta hattarnegolet adayin chamma bikde shehayyad soledet bo, apillu lo hayeta chamma ella rega echad — hare beotah rega shebbetok happesach chozra hachitta upolta taam mashshehu letok hattarnegolet veoseret et kullah im hattarnegolet hi shemena. Veim hi kechusha — tzarik lehasir mimmenna bimqom hachitta koobi rochab gudal. Uleminhag medinot ellu sheen mechalleqin ben kechusha lishmena — hare kol hattarnegolet asura bekol inyan:

Keli sheh[u]a balua mechametz shennitorba bekelim acherim — eno mitbattel betokam apillu hen elep. Vetzarik lehagil et kullam im rotzeh lehishtammesh bahen bechammin letzorek akilat happesach, o letzorek akilat ereb pesach mishshaa h' vaelak, dekevan sheal yede hagala epshar lehaprid min hakkelim et haissur habbalua bakkeli — hare zeh ke"dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" sheeno batel leolam (veap al gab debishar issurin lo qayyama lan haki, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"b, mikkol maqom bechametz bepesach machamirin tepe). Lepikak im haya keli zeh shennibla bo chametz keli cheres sheeno nikshar behagala — hare hu mitbattel berob kele cheres acherim shel hetter, umuttar lehishtammesh bekol hakkelim bechammin beereb pesach ad hallayla, umuttar leekol chammin hallalu betok happesach. Abal asur lehishtammesh bahen bechammin betok happesach, kedin yabesh beyabesh shennitbattel berob qodem happesach shehu chozer veneor bepesach:

Perusat pat shennapal leyayin tzonen, ap al pi shennetalah mishsham qodem happesach, mikkol maqom yesh lachosh shemma nitpareru mimmennu perurin daqqin venisharu betok hayyayin, ulepikak im lo sinnenu et hayyayin ad shenniknas happesach — hare niplat taam happerurin letok hayyayin bepesach al yede shennikbeshu betoko meet leet, dehaynu mishshaa shennapal letoko ad shaa shemmesanneno betok happesach, shebbesop hammeet leet naasa kimbushshal kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"h, veaz hu polet, veholek tamo letok hayyayin veneesar kol hayyayin apillu bahanaa, veasur lehashhoto ad leachar happesach. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshessinneno betok happesach umatza bo perurin daqqin, abal im adayin lo sinneno — muttar lehashhoto ad leachar happesach. Veken muttar lehanot mimmennu bekol mine hanaot betok happesach, kevan shekkebar hesir mimmennu qodem happesach et happat shennapal letoko, veen bo ella chashash beolma shemma nisharu bo perurin, veday leesor oto bishtiyya. Veim nitareb miyyayin zeh leyayin acher — gam hu asur bishtiyya. Veim sinnen oto*[vaapillu im sinneno betok happesach velo matza shum perur al hamsannenet, ap al pi ken yesh lachosh shemma haya bo perur daq meod sheeno nirgash birut haayin mechamat shehu meorab belachluchit yayin sheal pi hamsannenet, veniplat tamo bepesach letok hayyayin. Umikkol maqom, im en meet leet mishshaa shennapal happat letok hayyayin ad shaa shemmesanneno betok happesach — en lachosh shemma niplat taam happerurin letok hayyayin kemo shehu tzonen. Veap al pi sheyyesh machamirin bechametz bepesach apillu nishra hechametz betzonen kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z, mikkol maqom kevan sheen kan chametz gamur ella sapeq shemma nisharu bo perurin daqqin — yesh lehaqel baddabar. Vaapillu im keshessinneno betok happesach matza perurin al pi hamsannenet shebbevadday hayu betok hayyayin bepesach, mikkol maqom im hu sheat haddechaq kegon shehu tzarik leyayin zeh learba kosot o leqiddush ulehabdala — yesh lismok al haomerim shechametz bepesach eno oser bepachot mimmeet leet]: qodem happesach — muttar lishtoto bepesach bekol inyan, apillu yesh kamma yamim mishshaa shennapal happat letoko ad shaa shemmesanneno, sheap shenniplat taam happat letok hayyayin — hare kebar nitbattel beshishshim qodem happesach, veeno chozer veneor:

Ukeshemmesanneno ben qodem happesach ben tok happesach — tzarik lizzaher lesanneno bebeged ab qetzat, shello yukal shum perur daq laabor tok niqbe habbeged. Lepikak, im napal pat letok me debash, im hu ab qetzat shello yukal laabor beged shehu ab qetzat — en lo taqqana lishtoto bepesach ap al pi shehesir mimmennu et happat shennapal letoko, shemma nisharu sham perurin daqqin:

Kol mine meluchim muttar leoklam bepesach min haddin belo shum sheriyya vahadacha kelal ap al pi shello nizharu bahen mechimmutz, dehaynu shello badequ et hammelach mipperure chametz shedderek lehimmatze bo, shehare ap al pi shehayu bo perure chametz — kebar nimmosu venimmochu venitbattelu beshishshim qodem happesach. Vaapillu nimlechu betok keli shel chametz ben yomo, dehaynu shennishtammeshu bo chametz bechammin tok meet leet lammelicha, sheadayin lo nipgam chametz habbalua bakkeli, ap al pi ken en hammelach maplito min hakkeli umablio baokel hannimlach betoko, lepi sheen koach bemelach ella lehaplit mohal min haokel shehu rak, abal lo min hakkeli shehu qasheh:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemine meluchim yebeshim, kegon gebina melucha vedagim meluchim sheenan sheruyim bemayim o betzir meet leet betok keli chametz, abal im hayu sheruyim bemayim o betzir meet leet, apillu lo haya hakkeli ben yomo beshaa shennatenu hammaliach letoko — asur (veayyen beyoreh dea siman q"h delo neesar ella mah shemmunnach mimmennu betok hammayim vehatztzir, abal hammiqtzat sheyyotze chutz mehammayim vehatztzir lo neesar) leoklo apillu beyom tob haacharon shel galuyyot. Ap al pi shehotzi mehakkeli shel chametz qodem happesach vehedicho yapeh yapeh bikli shel pesach min hammelach haddabuq bo, mikkol maqom kevan shennikbash meet leet betok keli shel chametz — hare niplat taam hechametz min hakkeli letoko al yede kebisha zo, shekkol hakkabush meet leet — hare hu kimbushshal. Veap al pi shehakkeli lo haya ben yomo venipgam taam hechametz shebbetoko, mikkol maqom keshehattaam happagum nibla letok hammaliach shehu charip vechazaq mechamat taam hammelach shenniknas bo — hare taam pagum zeh nehepak bo leshebach, shehachariput mebattel et pegimato:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemaliach shehu maluach harbeh meod, kemo shehu derek limloach basar o dagim kede sheyyitqayyemu zeman merubbeh umarbim bahem melach, ulepikak ap shehen sheruyin bemayim en hammayim mebattelin chariputan. Abal im eno maluach kol kak — eno niqra dabar charip, kevan shehu sharuy bammayim hen mebattelin et chariputo. Ulepikak apillu im haya hakkeli ben yomo beshaa shekkebashuhu letoko — muttar leoklo bepesach, shehare lo niplat hechametz mehakkeli letoko ad sop meet leet mishshaa shennikbash, ubarega hahi shebbesop hammeet leet kebar yesh yoter mimmeet leet mishshaa shennibla hechametz letok hakkeli, ukebar nipgam tamo:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennatan alayv hammayim qodem shennira hatztzir betok hakkeli shel chametz shennikbash betoko, o apillu lo natan alayv et hammayim ad leachar shennira tzir betok hakkeli, ella shello shaha hatztzir betok hakkeli (qodem shennatan alayv mayim) keshiur bishshul, dehaynu bikde sheim haya noten hakkeli im hatztzir shebbetoko al gabbe haur haya hatztzir matchil lehartiach, abal im lo natan alayv mayim ad leachar sheshshaha hatztzir betok hakkeli keshiur bishshul, im haya hakkeli ben yomo — asur leekol mehammaliach shennikbash betoko apillu beyom tob haacharon, lepi shehatztzir hu dabar charip, kevan shehu yotze mehammaliach al yede koach hammelach shealayv, hare kol koach hammelach batztzir, vedino keroteach gamur, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman s"t vetz"a, vekevan sheshshaha hatztzir bakkeli keshiur bishshul — hare hu keillu nitbashshel betoko venibla chariput hatztzir betok hakkeli, veal yede ken naasa taam hechametz habbalua bakkeli charip meat al yede chariput hatztzir shenniknas betoko, vekevan shettaam hechametz habbalua bakkeli naasa charip meat beodo meshubbach, dehaynu beod shehakkeli hu ben yomo — eno nipgam leolam apillu leachar kamma yamim:

Umikkol maqom, im hu yodea shiur hammaqom min hakkeli shehaya bo hatztzir qodem shennatan bo hammayim, ubarur lo sheyyesh shishshim bammaliach hannikbash im me hakkebisha keneged oto maqom min hakkeli bekol obyo — muttar leekol maliach zeh bepesach, shehare lo niknas chariput hatztzir ella beoto maqom min hakkeli shehaya munnach alayv, ushear hechametz habbalua bishar hakkeli hu noten taam lipgam beshaa shenniplat letok hammaliach, dehaynu leachar meet leet mishshaa shennikbash hammaliach bammayim betok keli zeh:

Umikkol maqom, lepi minhag medinot ellu sheoserin noten taam lipgam bepesach — asur leoklo bepesach bekol inyan, ella im ken hotzio qodem happesach min hakkeli shel chametz shehaya sharuy betoko, abal keshehu sharuy betoko betok happesach ap al pi shello abar adayin meet leet mishshaa shennishra betoko ad shaa shehu rotzeh liqnoto uleoklo bepesach, vekol tzonen shehu sharuy bikli eno maplit kelum mehakkeli pachot [mi]meet leet kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z, mikkol maqom lekattechilla tob lizzaher milliqnoto im en sham sheat haddechaq, abal im yesh sheat haddechaq muttar liqnoto uleoklo bepesach im adayin lo abar meet leet mishshaa shennishra bikli shel chametz ad shaa shemmotzio mittoko bepesach. Abal im kebar abar meet leet — asur leoklo bepesach apillu al yede sheriyya vahadacha. Vaapillu im keli zeh shel chametz zeh shennikbash betoko lo nibla bo meolam kol kak chametz shello yihyeh baddabar shennikbash betoko shishshim keneged hechametz habbalua bakkeli, mikkol maqom kevan shehu kabush betoko betok happesach, vechametz bepesach bemashshehu, veen lo bittul leolam, apillu hu noten taam lipgam lepi minhagenu:

Abal im hotzio mehakkeli shel chametz qodem happesach, ap al pi shehu maluach harbeh meod vehaya kabush betok hakkeli kamma yamim, mikkol maqom im lo nibla meolam kol kak chametz bikli zeh shello yihyeh bemaliach zeh shishshim kenegdo — muttar leoklo bepesach, sheap im niplat hechametz mehakkeli letoko hare nitbattel beshishshim qodem happesach, veeno chozer veneor bepesach:

Basar shemmelachuhu betok keli shel chametz apillu hu ben yomo venikbash betoko kamma yamim betok hatztzir shenniplat mimmennu, ap al pi shennimlach habbasar harbeh meod vahare chariputo mebattel pegimat taam hechametz shenniplat letoko, mikkol maqom im achar kak nityabbesh habbasar kemo shehu derek leyabbesh basar kede sheyyitqayyem lizman merubbeh — muttar leoklo bepesach, dekevan shennityabbesh nitbattel taam hechametz shebbetoko:

Veim basar yabesh zeh haya taluy becheder shemmeraqqedin sham qemach — en sheriyya vahadacha moil lo lehattiro bepesach, shehaqqemach eno ober al yede hadacha, veadderabba hu mitdabbeq venaaseh perure batzeq daqqin meod venidbaqin meod babbasar:
Veken shear okalin umashqin vekelim shel pesach — tzarik lehazhir laam shello yeraqqedu qemach besamuk lahem maqom sheabaq haqqemach yakol lehaggia alehem:

Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal kebar nahagu bimdinot ellu lehachamir lekattechilla shello leekol bepesach ad yom tob haacharon shel galuyyot kol mine meluchim shello nizharu libdoq hammelach mipperure chametz hannimtzaim bo, lepi sheanu chosheshin shemma yesh alehen adayin perur daq shel chametz beayin shennidbaq bo min hammelach umechamat daqquto eno nireh laayin. Vaapillu im hu rotzeh lishrotan bemayim ulehadichan yapeh venimtza sheap im haya alehem mashshehu chametz beayin kebar yaabor al yede sheriyya vahadacha — ap al pi ken asur, gezera shemma yishkach veyoklenna belo hadacha. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemine meluchim shedderek leoklam bekol hashshana belo hadacha, kegon dagim lachim meluchim shennimlechu mizzeman qarob, umine qishshuin (sheqqorin ugerqes) velimoni"sh meluchim ukebushim, ugebina melucha, vekol kayyotze bahen, abal mine meluchim shebbekol hashshana enan neekalim belo hadacha, kegon dagim yebeshim, o hammeluchim bechabit (sheqqorin herineg), shehen meluchin mizzeman merubbeh veenan neekalin belo hadacha, ubasar maluach apillu hu lach vaapillu nimlach miqqarob en darko leheakel belo hadacha, ulepikak en lachosh shemma yishkach lehadicho, umuttar leoklo bepesach al yede hadacha, sheyyashrennu shalosh peamim bemayim. (Veim yashrennu betok keli shel pesach vegam yedichennu yapeh) [qodem happesach betok keli shel pesach vidichennu yapeh] veyaabor mealayv mashshehu chametz haddabuq bo [vehammachamir bekol inyan] — hare zeh meshubbach:

Abal karkashot yebeshot shennimlechu bemelach shello nibdaq mehechametz — en sheriyya vahadacha moil lahen lehattiran leoklan bepesach. Apillu im hammuleyta shebbipnim hu mibbasar shennimlach venikshar leshem pesach, mikkol maqom hare beshaa shemmalechu hakkarkashot lehakshiran mide daman malechu otan batztzad hachitzon shellahem, maqom shehashshumman dabuq sham, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman a"h, veachar kak mehappekin otam vetzad hachitzon shennimlach hu mibbipnim, vehaek toil lo hadacha shemmibbachutz:

Vekol minhagim ellu hen lekattechilla, abal bediabad shekkebar bishshel echad middebarim hallalu belo shum hadacha usheriyya, vei epshar leqayyem otam ad leachar happesach shello yitqalqel — maamidin al iqqar haddin, umuttar leoklo bepesach. Veen tzarik lomar im nitareb echad middebarim hallalu bidbarim acherim apillu bepachot mishshishshim — muttar leekol kol hattaarobot betok happesach, apillu epshar leqayyemo ad leachar happesach:

Im hu sheat haddechaq sheen lo basar acher leyom tob raq karkashot hammemullaim bebasar shennimlach bemelach shello nibdaq mipperure chametz vegam nechtak daq daq besakkin shel chametz, ap al pi shemmin hassetam lo haya hassakkin mequnnach yapeh qodem shechatak bo habbasar, veyesh omerim shekkol sakkin shel chametz sheeno mequnnach yapeh i epshar shello yehe mashshehu chametz dabuq bo, veim ken yesh lachosh shemma al yede dochaq hassakkin babbasar bachatikato niprad mashshehu chametz min hassakkin venidbaq babbasar, ukeshemmaggia happesach adayin hechametz mashshehu beayin betok habbasar shebbakkarkashot, kevan shehu sheat haddechaq yesh lismok al dibre haomerim distam sakkin shemmechattekin bo mequnnach hu min hechametz haddabuq bo, shehechametz eno dabar hannisrak venidbaq, ubeqinnuach meat hu niprad mehassakkin:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen bammilluy shebbetok hakkarkashot lo shum velo batzal velo shear dabar charip, abal im yesh bo echad mehaddebarim hacharipim — asur leekol karkashot ellu apillu beyom tob haacharon shel galuyyot. Veim napal mehem letok hattabshil, im hu betok happesach — hare hem oserin et hattabshil bemashshehu, shehare haddabar hecharip shebbetoko bevadday nechtak besakkin shel chametz [kevan shello hayeta kavvanato leekol mehen bepesach, vekol dabar charip shennechtak besakkin shel chametz] apillu haya mequnnach venaqi velo haya ben yomo — asur leoklo apillu beyom tob haacharon, veoser et taarobto bemashshehu betok happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beshum ubatzal shebbetok hammuleyta, abal shum shechotekin oto daq daq umeorbin oto bammelach shemmolechin bo basar leyabbesh kede sheyyihyeh reach hashshum nodep letok habbasar — muttar leekol habbasar bepesach al yede sheriyya vahadacha, sheap shehashshum nechtak besakkin shel chametz, mikkol maqom al yede sheriyya vahadacha nopel iqqar kol mammashut hashshum meal gabbe habbasar, velo nishar bo ella recho, vereach zeh eno ella mehashshum bilbaddo, veen bo kelum mereach chametz habbalua bassakkin shennechtak bo hashshum:

Im hu sheat haddechaq sheen lo basar leyom tob raq dagim meluchim o basar maluach shennimlechu bemelach shello nibdequ mipperure chametz velo hedicham qodem happesach — muttar lishrotam ulehadicham betok happesach, vaapillu betok keli shel chametz im en lo keli shel pesach, ubilbad shello yashreh betoko meet leet, shebbepachot mimmeet leet en mayim tzonenin maplitin kelum mehakkeli, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z:

Asur leekol bepesach ad yom tob haacharon mehashshumman shehittikuhu qodem happesach im lo nitkavvenu behattakato kede leoklo bepesach, shebbevadday lo nizharu bo mechimmutz bishat hattakato, veyesh lachosh shemma nitareb az betoko perur chametz mashshehu vaadayin hu omed beeno betok hashshumman, shehare happerur eno mitareb veniblal yapeh betok hashshumman sheyyitbattel beshishshim qodem happesach. Umikkol maqom, im nitareb bemaakalim acherim betok happesach — eno oser taarobto bemashshehu, ella mitbattel hu beshishshim, kevan sheen bo ella chashash mashshehu chametz. Ubimqom hepsed merubbeh o bishat haddechaq — yesh lehaqel apillu im nitareb bepachot mishshishshim. Veim chazar vehittik shumman zeh qodem happesach vesinnen oto bebeged ab qetzat kede leoklo bepesach — hare zeh muttar, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal bepesach en sinnun moil lo, shehare tzarik lehattiko qodem hassinnun, venimtza sheim hayu betoko perure chametz ap al pi shessinneno mittoko hare kebar nitbashshelu betoko veniplat taman letoko vechametz bepesach bemashshehu, vegam yesh lachosh shemma hayu betoko perure chametz venimmochu al yede habbishshul:

Vaapillu hu omer: "bari li shello nitareb bazeh shum perure chametz beshaa shehittikuhu qodem happesach" — en zeh kelum, lepi sheen zoker ella dabar sheasa bemitkavven, vedabar shennitkavven nizhar laasoto, abal zeh shebbeshaa shehittik et hashshumman lo haya dato al happesach velo nitkavven lehizzaher bo mipperure chametz, im ken ap im nitareb bo perur mashshehu lo haya dato alayv velo hishgiach bo, veeno nizkar mizzeh leachar zeman:

Abal im nitkavven behattakato kede leekol mimmennu bepesach venizhar bo mipperure chametz, ap al pi shehittiko betok qedera shel chametz bat yomah — muttar leoklo bepesach, shehare en bo ella noten taam ben noten taam shel hetter, kelomar shello niplat letok hashshumman shum taam min hechametz atzmo, ella min hechametz niplat laqqedera umiqqedera lashshumman, vahare yesh kan [noten taam] ben noten taam, vaadayin hakkol hetter kevan sheadayin lo higgia happesach velo neesar hechametz kelal, ulepikak muttar leoklo betok happesach, dekol taam sheeno niplat mammashut hammaakal atzmo hu qalush meod, ukeshehu nibla betok maakal acher beshaa shettaam zeh muttar adayin baakila — en bo koach leesor achar kak kesheyyaggia zeman issuro. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shello hittiru noten taam ben noten taam shel hetter ella keshehahetter vehaissur hen shemot mechullaqin, sheen shemotehen shavin zeh lazeh, kegon basar bechalab, shebbasar lebaddo hu hetter gamur ushemo basar, venoten taam ben noten taam shello muttar leoklo bechalab, dekevan shettaam habbasar niqlash kol kak — en bo mammashut kol kak sheyyukal lachul alayv shem chadash shel issur, dehaynu shem "basar bechalab", abal noten taam ben noten taam shel chametz, ap al pi sheqqodem happesach hu adayin shel hetter, mikkol maqom keshemmaggia zeman issuro lo chal alayv shem chadash, shehare mittechilla ap al pi shehaya qalush meod haya shemo chametz veakshav shemo chametz, ella shead akshav lo asaro hakkatub, veakshav hu kachatikat nebela, vekevan sheen kan shem chadash ella issur habba meelayv — yakol hu lachul apillu al taam qalush kazeh, kevan shemmeelayv hu neesar, ulepikak asur leekol mishshumman zeh apillu beereb pesach mishshaa chamishit vaelak, vaapillu beyom tob haacharon. Abal im qodem happesach era shumman zeh keshehu roteach letok keli acher — muttar lehishtammesh beoto keli bepesach belo heksher, dekevan shettaam chametz shebbashshumman hu qalush meod — en bo koach lehiqqarot shem chametz leoto meat shumman shennibla betok hakkeli kede sheyyeaser kesheyyaggia happesach. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beshumman vekayyotze bo bidbarim sheenam charipim, abal dabar charip shennitbashshel bikli chametz, ap al pi shello haya ben yomo veera oto keshehu roteach letok keli acher shel pesach — asur lehishtammesh bo bepesach belo heksher apillu beyom tob haacharon, lepi shehachariput motzi et iqqar vegup hattaam habbalua, vahare zeh keillu haya meqabbel haddabar charip et taam hechametz min mammashut hechametz atzmo velo al yede hakkeli, venimtza sheddabar hecharip hu noten taam rishon shel hechametz, vehakkeli shel pesach sheeruhu letoko hu noten taam sheni, vaadayin yesh alayv shem taam chametz, veneesar keshemmaggia happesach. Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehachamir lekattechilla kassebara haacharona. Abal im betok happesach nitareb hashshumman zeh bemaakalim acherim — eno oser bemashshehu, kemo sheim haya balua betoko taam mammashut hechametz atzmo, ella mitbattel hu beshishshim, kevan shellepi sebara harishona muttar leoklo belo shum bittul. Veyesh omerim sheapillu shishshim en tzarik lebattelo, lepi shebbediabad somekin legamre al sebara harishona. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq:

Veken haddin beyayin mebushshal ume debash vekayyotze bahen shennitbashshelu bikli chametz ben yomo qodem happesach, sheasur lishtotan bepesach apillu beyom tob haacharon shel galuyyot. Vaapillu im eno yodea im nitbashshelu bikli shehu ben yomo o bikli sheeno ben yomo, usetam kelim enan bene yoman, mikkol maqom mishshum chumrat chametz yesh lehachamir velachosh shemma haya hakkeli ben yomo, veen lishtot shum mashqeh shennitbashshel bistam keli ella im ken beyadua sheeno ben yomo. Vehu shello yihyeh dabar charip, abal im hu dabar charip, kegon mirqachat shennaasa middabar qiyyuha vecharip — en leoklo apillu beyom tob haacharon, shehachariput mebattel et pegimut hattaam shenniplat mehakkeli sheeno ben yomo venaaseh bo taam leshebach.*[Lepikak im heemid gebina qodem happesach bechalab (tzalul) hannimtza betok haqqeba shehu charip vechamutz umaamidin bo gebinot, vezeh hechalab haya meet leet betok keli shel chametz, apillu lo haya ben yomo — asur leekol gebina zo bepesach apillu beyom tob haacharon, ella im ken yesh bechalab sheheemid mimmennu haggebina shishshim keneged hechalab shel qeba sheheemid bo, o sheyyesh bo shishshim keneged hakkeli shel chametz shechaleb haqqeba haya betokah meet leet, denimtza shettaam chametz shebbachaleb haqqeba nitbattel beshishshim betok chaleb haggebina qodem happesach, veeno chozer veneor bepesach. Velo ameru: dabar hammaamid apillu beelep lo batel, ella keshehaddabar hammaamid hu asur mechamat atzmo, abal im eno asur ella mechamat shennibla bo issur, kegon taam chametz habbalua bachaleb haqqeba — hare hu mitbattel beshishshim, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman p"z, shehare issur habbalua eno maamid kelal]: veken me debash shennitbashshel beyora shebbishshelu bah yen-sarap, apillu yesh kamma yamim ben b' habbishshulim — asur lishtoto apillu beyom tob haacharon, shehayyen- sarap hu charip meod umechamat chariputo en tamo (habbalua bayyora) nipgam apillu leachar kamma yamim, vehu noten taam leshebach beme debash, lepikak en liqqach beyom tob haacharon me debash shel kol hashshana ella miyyisrael sheyyodea shello bishshelo beyora shebbishshel bah yen-sarap, vegam nizhar millehachmitzo bishmarim shel shekar:

Dabar sheeno charip shennitbashshel bikli chametz sheyyadua shello haya ben yomo, kegon shebbishshelo leshem happesach veqodem happesach era oto mehakkeli chametz letok keli shel pesach — muttar lo lishtoto bepesach, kemo shennitbaer lemala, shekkol noten taam lipgam shennaasa qodem happesach — eno chozer veneor bepesach. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla asur lebashshel leshem pesach bikli shel chametz sheeno ben yomo, sheasur laasot noten taam lipgam lekattechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"g. Abal im lo bishshelo leshem happesach, ap al pi shehu omer: "bari li shello haya hakkeli ben yomo mibbeliat hechametz beshaa shennitbashshel bo" — en zeh kelum, veen lishtot mimmennu ad yom tob haacharon, dekevan shebbeshaa shebbishshelo lo hayeta dato al happesach, velo haya tzarik ledaqdeq im hakkeli eno ben yomo. Veap lepi debarayv sheomer shebbari li shello haya ben yomo, hare hu lo nitkavven lekak, veen adam zoker mah shennaasa shello bemitkavven, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal im beshaa shebbishshelo diqdeq venizhar shello lebashshelo bikli shehu balua mechametz, ap al pi shello hayeta kavvanato leshem happesach ella mechamat dabar acher nizhar bazeh, kegon shebbishshelo bikli chadash lirpua vekayyotze bazeh — muttar lishtoto bepesach. Umikkol maqom, mechamat chashash shemma nitareb bo perur chametz mashshehu — tzarik lesanneno qodem happesach. Veim lo sinneno qodem happesach — tzarik lesanneno betok happesach. Veim lo matza shum perur chametz al pi hamsannenet — muttar lishtoto, veen anu chosheshin shemma yesh perur daq sheeno nireh, kevan shello rainu meolam shennapal letoko chametz:

Hambashshel me debash letzorek happesach verotzeh lehachmitzo — lo yishpekennu letok keli hammeyuchad lekak (sheqqorin qvvasny"q bilshon ruseya) shehu mechammetz kol me debash sheshshopekin letoko, lepi shehakkoach hamchammetz habbalua meoto keli hu mechamat shemmachmitzin betoko me debash kol hashshana, vehen chametz gamur shennitchammetzu beshimre shekar, vegam nitbashshelu beyora shel shekar o shel yen-sarap:

Yesh nohagin lehachamir shello lehistappeq bepesach mechometz yayin shemmistappeqin mimmennu kol hashshana. Ap al pi shennizharu shello lishob mimmennu bikle chametz, mikkol maqom chosheshin shemma hecheziru letoko chometz shennishar misseuda, velipamim yesh bechometz zeh mipperure lechem shennapelu betok hasseuda. Ubimqomot hallalu sheen chometz yayin matzuy — en nohagin lehachamir bazeh, kevan shei epshar limtzo chometz acher beqal:
Bimqomot shemmeorbin tzuqer bechometz yayin — en lehistappeq mimmennu bepesach, ella im ken sinneno qodem happesach ayyen siman ts"z:

Yesh nizharin kol sheloshim yom lipne happesach shello lishob bikli chametz min yayin vechometz hammutzna lepesach, ella im ken hakkeli chametz hu moraq veshuttap sheen bo shum likluk chametz. Veim lo nizharu veshaabu mimmennu bikli chametz sheeno moraq veshuttap — nizharin shello lishtoto bepesach. Abal meiqqar haddin en kan chashash issur, shehare setam kelim hen neqiyyim veen bahem likluk beayin, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"h, umah shebbalua bedopne hakkeli eno niplat betzonen ella al yede kebisha meet leet, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"h:

Yayin laban shehukha marito verotzim letaqqeno al yede shemmesimin letoko meat chaleb behema umeat cheleb chitta — tzerikin lehizzaher sheyyihyeh behayyayin shishshim kenegdan, gezera shemma yishteh mimmennu bepesach, o shemma yishteh oto im basar, kevan sheen hechalab nikkar bo, abal kesheyyesh bo shishshim en kan chashash issur. Veap al pi sheasur lebattel issur bayyadayim beshishshim, mikkol maqom kevan sheen kavvanato letaqqeno kede lishtoto im basar o kede lishtoto bepesach, ella kavvanato letaqqeno kede lishtoto lebaddo qodem happesach o leacharayv, im ken eno mebattel shum issur kelal. Veachar shennitbattel hechalab beshishshim betok hayyayin — muttar lishtoto im basar, abal asur lishtoto bepesach (ella im ken sinneno qodem happesach), lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma en kol cheleb chitta balul yapeh yapeh betok hayyayin ella nitzlal mimmennu meat veyarad lematta vehu omed beeno betok hayyayin bepesach veniplat mimmennu taam mashshehu letok hayyayin:

Chabit shel yayin sheyyesh bah mashshehu batzeq sheddabequ bo nesarim, ap al pi shebbatzeq zeh hu chametz nuqsheh — asur lishtot miyyayin shel chabit zo bepesach, lepi shenniplat mimmennu taam mashshehu letok hayyayin bepesach, veeno mitbattel beshishshim, kevan shehu natan hayyayin bayyadayim letok chabit zo sheyyesh bah batzeq dabuq — hare zeh kemitkavven lebattel issur bayyadayim, ulepikak en lo bittul olamit, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"t. Veap sheaz beshaa shennatan et hayyayin sham hayeta sheat hetter akilat chametz, mikkol maqom en zeh moil ella lehattaarobet shennaasa bishat hetter, dehaynu hattaam shenniplat mehabbatzeq letok hayyayin qodem happesach hu mitbattel beshishshim, veeno chozer veneor bepesach kevan shekkebar nitbattel bishat hetter, abal hattaarobet shennaasa bishat issur, dehaynu hattaam shenniplat mehabbatzeq betok happesach — eno mitbattel apillu beelep, kevan shettaarobet zeh naasa bayyadayim al yede shennatan hayyayin bechabit zo sheyyesh bah batzeq. Veap sheaz hayeta sheat hetter, mikkol maqom al yede ken naasa taarobet gam bishat issur:

Veim batzeq zeh dabaq b' chodashim qodem happesach — bevadday kebar nitqashsha keshehiggia happesach veen niplat mimmennu shum taam, ulekak muttar lishtot yayin zeh bepesach. Umikkol maqom, im yesh mibbatzeq zeh kezayit bemaqom echad missidqe hechabit — chayyab lebaaro keshemmaggia happesach, o sheyyatiach alayv tit, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Kol dabar shehu charip, kegon melach o boser vekayyotze bahen middebarim hacharipim sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"v, shenniddoku bimdoka shel chametz apillu enah bat yomah vehi mudachat uneqiyya sheen bah mashshehu beayin — asur leoklam bepesach, ap al pi shenniddoku qodem happesach, lepi sheal yede chariputam veal yede dochaq haddika hen bolein mechametz habbalua bammedoka. Umikkol maqom, bammedoka shellanu sheen regilin laduk bahen chametz, veen bahem chashash ella shemma niddak bahen mashshehu chametz betok hattebalin hacharipim shenniddoku bahem kol hashshana, veim ken ap im niplat mehem taam mashshehu chametz letok hammelach o tebalin hacharipim shenniddoku bahen kebar nitbattel taam zeh beshishshim qodem happesach, ulepikak muttar leekol melach utebalin hallalu betok happesach:

Melach hannatun bikli shel chametz, ap al pi shemmin haddin muttar leoklo bepesach, im hakkeli haya naqi, vaapillu im eno yodea im haya naqi — hare setam kelim neqiyyim hen, veen hammelach maplit mah shebbalua betok hakkeli ella im ken niddok betoko. Mikkol maqom hammachamir [shello] lehishtammesh bepesach bemelach shehaya munnach bikli habbalua mechametz apillu lo haya ben yomo vehaya mudach venaqi — tabo alayv beraka, lepi sheyyesh mi sheomer shehammelach yesh lo koach lehaplit mah shebbalua betok hakkeli. Umikkol maqom, melach hannatun bikli sheen regilin lehishtammesh bo chametz bechammin, kegon medoka vekayyotze bah — en lehachamir:

Kol dabar sheeno charip shenniddok bikli habbalua mechametz apillu hu ben yomo — muttar leoklo bepesach, apillu niddok betok happesach, lepi sheen haddika mapletet mah shebbalua betok hakkeli keshehanniddak eno dabar charip. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bistam keli, shemmin hassetam hu naqi veen bo likluk chametz beayin, abal im niddak bikli shehu meluklak qetzat mechametz, apillu niddok qodem happesach — asur leoklo bepesach, apillu im rotzeh lehadicho yapeh yapeh, lepi sheal yede dochaq haddika nibla betoko qetzat min hallikluk shehaya beayin al pene hakkeli, veeno niplat mimmennu al yede hadacha:

Kol dabar sheeno charip shennechtak besakkin shel chametz apillu hu ben yomo — muttar leoklo bepesach al yede sheyyedichennu yapeh bimqom hachatak (veayyen beyoreh dea siman tz"v dibqishshuim en hadacha moelet kelum, vetzarik ligror meqom hachatak, ayyen sham hattaam). Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennechtak bebeto, shehu aqray beolma, abal dabar shennechtak besakkin shel chametz biqbiut beyad hannokri, kegon chatikat dag (sheqqorin laqsin) shemmokerim hannokrim bepesach, vehu nechtak bepesach bassakkinim shellahem shechotekin bahen pat — tob lehachamir mishshum chumrat chametz shello leekol bepesach apillu al yede hadacha. Abal keshechatakuhu qodem happesach — en tzarik lehachamir, umuttar leoklo bepesach al yede hadacha. Veim lo hedichuhu venapal letok hattabshil bepesach — hare kol hattabshil asur, ap al pi sheyyesh bo shishshim keneged oto dabar shennechtak besakkin shel chametz, vaapillu nechtak bebeto beaqray beolma besakkin sheyyadua lo shello haya ben yomo, mikkol maqom im lo qinnach et hassakkin yapeh qodem shechatak oto dabar, min hassetam haya meat chametz dabuq bo, ukeshennechtak bo oto dabar al yede dochaq hassakkin bachatikato niprad mashshehu chametz min hassakkin venidbaq baddabar shennechtak, ukeshennapal oto dabar im mashshehu chametz haddabuq bo letok hattabshil — neesar kol hattabshil mechamat hammashshehu chametz. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shello ameru chakamim: setam sakkin eno naqi, ella min shamnunit, shehu dabar hannidbaq venisrak, abal chametz sheeno dabar nidbaq venisrak lo, beqinnuach meat hu niprad mehassakkin, hare kol setam sakkin naqi hu mimmennu, ulepikak kol dabar sheeno charip shennechtak besakkin shel chametz, apillu nechtak biqbiut beyad hannokri betok happesach, veqodem shehedicho napal letok hattabshil — hare hattabshil muttar baakila ap al pi sheen bo shishshim kenegdo. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh o bishat haddechaq, kegon letzorek simchat yom tob sheen lo maakalim acherim kol tzorko, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Kol dabar charip shennechtak besakkin shel chametz, apillu eno ben yomo vehu naqi umequnnach yapeh, vaapillu nechtak qodem happesach — asur leoklo bepesach, lepi sheal yede chariputo veal yede dochaq hassakkin bachatikato niplat taam hechametz habbalua bassakkin venibla bannechtak, veal yede chariputo mebattel et pegimat hattaam mechamat sheeno ben yomo venaaseh taam leshebach:

Zetim mechamat merirutan hen niqrain dabar charip, veim chatakan besakkin shel chametz apillu eno naqi vehu ben yomo, veachar kak kabash otam bemelach umayim bikli shel chametz ben yomo — hare me hakkebisha muttarin bepesach, lepi shekkebar nitbattel bahen hechametz beshishshim qodem happesach. Abal hazzetim atzman asurin apillu lo haya hassakkin ben yomo, kevan shehen charipim. Veap al pi sheim netzarep kol hazzetim shennechteku besakkin zeh yesh bahen shishshim lebattel pelitat hassakkin, ap al pi ken kullam asurin, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma kol zayit vezayit nibla mashshehu mippelitat hassakkin velo nitpashshet mashshehu zeh bekol gup hazzayit sheyyitbattel betoko beshishshim, ella kol mashshehu zeh nibla bimqom hachatak vesamuk lo meat, beinyan sheyyesh bemashshehu zeh kede litten taam chametz gamur beoto maqom mehazzayit shehu balua betoko, veken yesh lachosh bekol zayit vezayit, ulekak kullam asurin, apillu beyom tob haacharon. Vaapillu im rotzeh lehasir mikkol zayit et meqom hachatak vesamuk lo meat veleekol hammotar — en zeh moil kelum, deepshar shebbekamma zetim nitpashsheta bahen pelitat hassakkin bekol gupan, ulepi sheen anu yodein oto lepikak kullam asurin. (Vaapillu im beshishshim zetim mehen yesh kede lebattel pelitat kol hassakkin beshishshim, veyesh kan od harbeh zetim meod kede lebattel hashshishshim zetim berob — en zeh kelum, shekkebar nitbaer shekkol yabesh beyabesh shennitbattel berob qodem happesach hu chozer veneor bepesach). Veim chazar ubishshel kol zetim ellu yachad qodem happesach — muttar leoklan bepesach, lepi sheal yede habbishshul niplat taam hechametz mimmaqom shehaya balua bekol zayit vezayit venitpashshet bekol gup hazzetim venitbattel beshishshim qodem happesach, veeno chozer veneor bepesach. Abal im lo bishshelan, ap al pi shehen kebushin bammayim kamma yamim, vekol kabush hu kimbushshal, mikkol maqom eno kimbushshal mammash, veen somekin al hakkebisha sheal yede ken yehe issur niplat mimmaqom shennibla bo kemo shessomekin al habbishshul, shehare heksher kelim haasurin hu al yede hagala bechammin, velo al yede kebisha bemayim tzonenin apillu kamma yamim. Veyesh omerim sheapillu bishshel kol hazzetim beyachad qodem happesach, vaapillu bishshel immahem od debarim acherim sheyyesh bahem shishshim keneged kol hazzetim, ap al pi ken hazzetim omedin beissuran bepesach, lepi shekkol zayit vezayit lo niplat mimmennu taam hechametz legamre al yede habbishshul, ella nishar bo mashshehu. Veap al pi shemmashshehu zeh nitpashshet al yede habbishshul bekol gup hazzayit venitbattel betoko beshishshim, mikkol maqom kevan sheqqodem shebbishshelo haya nirgash taam hechametz bemiqtzat hazzayit, dehaynu bimqom hachatak vesamuk lo meat, vehaya niqra shem chametz al oto taam habbalua beoto miqtzat kevan shello niplat mimmennu hechametz legamre — hare taam zeh niqra taam chametz kemo shehaya niqra qodem shebbishshelo, shehaya bo kede litten taam murgash beoto miqtzat. Vekevan sheyyesh sham chametz al taam mashshehu zeh habbalua beoto miqtzat — hare hu chozer veneor bepesach veoser et hammiqtzat hazzeh shehu balua betoko, vehechametz bepesach en lo bittul leolam kol zeman sheyyesh shem chametz alayv. Ulepi sheen anu yodeim kamma hu shiuro shel hammiqtzat hazzeh shehaya nirgash bo taam chametz qodem shennitbashshel, lepikak kol hazzayit asur, sheepshar shehaya nirgash bekullo, veken kol zayit vezayit yesh lehistappeq bo shemma haya nirgash taam hechametz bekullo. Abal chametz gamur shennitareb qodem happesach bepachot mishshishshim lach belach, kegon shekar letok me debash, veachar kak napal letoko od me debash qodem happesach beinyan sheyyesh ben hakkol shishshim keneged hashshekar shebbetokam — muttar lishtot hakkol bepesach, veen hashshekar chozer veneor. Ap al pi shennitareb techilla bepachot mishshishshim vehaya taam shekar nirgash battaarobot veniqra alayv shem chametz — en omerim: kevan shenniqra alayv shem chametz shub eno nipqa mimmennu, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"v, ayyen sham. Uleinyan halaka, kevan sheissur mashshehu bepesach middibre soperim — yesh lehaqel kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, hammachamir shello leoklam ad yom tob haacharon — tabo alayv beraka. Vekol zeh keshennechteku besakkin shel chametz, apillu hu mequnnach venaqi veeno ben yomo, abal im nizhar lechotkam besakkin chadasha, o shello nishtammesh bah chametz bechammin meolam — muttar leoklam bepesach meiqqar haddin, apillu nikbeshu qodem happesach bemelach umayim biqdera shel chametz shello hayeta bat yomah, lepi shehechametz shenniplat mehaqqedera lazzetim qodem happesach hu noten taam lipgam. Veap al pi shebbedabar charip en omerim noten taam lipgam, mikkol maqom kevan shennatan hammayim al hazzetim — kebar huchlash kochan venitbattel chariputan (al yede hammayim shennibleu bahem al yede kebisha zo). Vehu shehammayim hen harbeh mehazzetim, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qy"d. Veim nikbeshu bikli chametz ben yomo, dino kishar mine meluchim ukebushim sheen marbim bahem melach shennimlechu venikbeshu bikli shel chametz ben yomo, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Chametz dagan gamur shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, venitareb leachar happesach beshogeg, ben bemino ben besheeno mino, ben lach belach ben yabesh beyabesh — hare hu batel berob, umuttar apillu baakila, dekevan shechametz sheabar alayv happesach eno asur ella mishshum qenas sheqqenasuhu chakamim al sheabar alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", lepikak eno asur ella keshehu omed beeno kemo shehaya beshaa sheabar alayv, abal im nitareb achar kak berob hetter, kevan shennishtanna mikkemo shehaya beshaa sheabar alayv happesach — lo qenasuhu chakamim. Umikkol maqom, asur leorbo bayyadayim berob hetter, sheen mebattelin issur lekattechilla. Veim abar veerebo bemezid, dehaynu sheyyada sheasur leorbo veap al pi ken erebo berob hetter kede lebattelo — dino kishar mebattel issur bemezid, sheasur lo uleanshe beto umuttar laacherim, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"t, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh. Veyesh omerim shechametz sheabar alayv happesach kevan shehu asur middibre soperim hare dino kishar issure dibre soperim sheenan betelin bepachot mishshishshim im hattaarobot hu lach belach, ben shennitareb bemino ben shello bemino, ben sheyyesh battaarobet mammasho shel issur ben sheen sham ella tamo bilbad, kegon chatikat chametz sheabar alayv happesach shennopla letabshil roteach shel chametz shennitchammetz leachar happesach veen battabshil shishshim keneged hachatika — hare hattabshil asur baakila ubahanaa ap leachar shehesir hachatika mimmennu. Umikkol maqom, muttar lemokro lenokri, shehare en hannokri mosip lo damim bead taam hachatika shenniplat lesham, venimtza sheeno neheneh kelal mimmenna. Abal im yesh behattaarobet mammashut chametz sheabar alayv happesach — tzarik lizzaher shello yeqabbel damim mehannokri raq mah shehattaarobet haya shaveh qodem shennapal hechametz letoko, o sheyyeqabbel mimmennu kol deme hattaarobet im hechametz shebbetoko veyashlik deme hechametz leibbud, kegon layyam o lenahar amoq, denimtza sheeno neheneh kelal mechametz zeh. Vaapillu hu atzmo muttar leekol kol hattaarobet al yede sheyyipdeh et hechametz shebbetoko, dehaynu sheyyittol mimmaotayv sekum deme hechametz zeh veyashlikem leibbud, denimtza sheeno neheneh kelal bemah sheabar happesach al chametz zeh, veshub en lanu leqonso shello yoklennu, kevan shekkebar nitareb behetter. Veim hattaarobet hu yabesh beyabesh — hare hu batel berob kemo bishar issurin, umuttar apillu baakila. Veim en battaarobet rob keneged chametz zeh, kegon shennitareb echad beechad o shenayim bishnayim — tzarik lipdot et hechametz veachar kak yokal et kol hattaarobet, o sheyyimkor hakkol lenokri velo yeqabbel mimmennu raq machatzit haddamim, dehaynu deme hetter bilbad. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona. Abal im hu hepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq — yesh lismok al sebara harishona (ki ken iqqar):

Issa shennitchammetza leachar happesach beshimre shekar sheabar alayv happesach, ap al pi sheyyesh bah shishshim keneged hashshemarim — hare hi asura apillu bahanaa, dekevan shehashshemarim heemidu otah, vekol dabar hammaamid hare hu keillu hu omed beayin — hare keillu kol haissa hi shemarim. Lepikak, im hu rotzeh lemokrah lenokri velo yeqabbel mimmennu raq kemo shehayeta haissa shava qodem shennatan letokah hashshemarim — en zeh moil kelum, kevan sheanu roim kol haissa keillu hi shemarim. Veken im hu rotzeh lipdot et hashshemarim — en moil kelum, sheen pidyon moil ledabar shehu beayin. Veken haddin im heemid gebinot bechometz shel shekar sheabar alayv happesach, o sheheemid me debash beshimre shekar sheabar alayv happesach, veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheppidyon moil ledabar hammaamid. Veken yakol lemokro lenokri velo yeqabbel mimmennu deme dabar hammaamid. Ubimqom hepsed merubbeh yesh lismok al dibrehem:

Im laqach seor meissa shennitchammetza bisor sheabar alayv happesach, umeissa zo hashsheniyya laqach seor vechimmetz bo issa shelishit, umeissa zo hashshelishit laqach seor vechimmetz bo issa rebiit — hare issa zo harebiit mutteret apillu baakila belo shum pidyon. Abal issa hab' vehag' dinan kaissa harishona.
